    Looking for a 24/7 Gym in Woombye? Come Check Out Divinity Health and Fitness!

    We’re Divinity Health and Fitness, your local 24-hour gym located at 6/10 Blackall St, Woombye QLD 4559 – right behind Woombye Rural Supply!

    We’re more than just a gym. Our facility offers:

    24/7 Gym Access
    Personal Training
    Osteopathy
    MMA Classes
    Massage Therapy
    Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT)

    Whether you’re just starting your fitness journey or looking to take things to the next level, our friendly and professional team is here to support you every step of the way.

    Come meet the team in person:
    We’re available Monday to Friday between 6am and 4pm, or you can text/call us at 0455 558 278 with any questions.

    We’d love to welcome you to the Divinity Health and Fitness community!
